# @gnldev/cache

> 标签: agent, ai, ai-sdk, caching, durable, exactly-once, llm, ttl, typescript

## 简介

Cross-run content-hash cache on @gnldev/durable. Within-run reuse = journal replay; across-run reuse = cache.

- 官网：https://gnl.dev
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/gnlhq/gnldev.git
